added.summary: Bound CSS custom properties: an element's inline custom property, set from store data, which rules read with var() and children inherit (style:--fill={$hp / $max}). A store change re-resolves that element only; null leaves var()'s fallback.

added.member: UI documents: calc(), min(), max(), clamp()
added.summary: CSS math functions, reduced once their var()s are known (at cook, or when the element resolves): width: calc(var(--fill) * 100%), animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 80ms). Every term of one function takes one unit.
